rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Vibespace MCP Go Ternary provides real-time streaming of world moments and vibes through NATS, enabling multiplayer experiences with balanced ternary data representation. The implementation features robust access control with configurable sharing settings, rate limiting to prevent abuse, and comprehensive test coverage for reliability. It exposes JSON-RPC methods for resource reading and tool calling, with specialized streaming tools for starting/stopping streams, checking status, and updating configurations. This server is particularly valuable for collaborative virtual environments where users need to share contextual information with varying levels of privacy control.
